annotation.title_en: National Commission into the Regulation of AI in Healthcare - Summary minutes: first meeting (15 October 2025)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA), National Commission into the Regulation of AI in Healthcare
annotation.summary_en: Summary minutes of the first meeting of the UK's independent, non-statutory National Commission into the Regulation of AI in Healthcare, hosted by the MHRA. It advises on a new regulatory framework for healthcare AI, balancing patient safety, equity, trust and innovation. Recommendations are due summer 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Commission announced 26 September 2025 as an independent non-statutory advisory group hosted by MHRA
Tasked with recommending a new regulatory framework for AI and software as a medical device
Meets monthly until May 2026; recommendations due summer 2026
Themes: safety, equity, public trust, innovation, with patient safety paramount
Plans a call for evidence and public/practitioner attitude surveys
